name: Research correctness issue
about: Report a bug that may affect training, evaluation, protocol semantics, or research claims
title: "[research-correctness] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Affected component

Training / evaluator / data-reference handling / protocol / result artifact / documentation claim / other.

## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and why it may alter research meaning.

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide the smallest reproducible case, logs, result artifact, or code location available.

## Provenance

Include relevant commit, config, dataset/motion, checkpoint, evaluator version, and seed when applicable.

## Potentially affected results

List results or claims that may need to be invalidated or re-evaluated. Do not assume the scope is zero if it has not been checked.
